readings: Select patients who have at least one laboratory record where both `U-PRO` and `RA` are exactly '-'. For each selected patient, use all their laboratory records to calculate the average non-missing `PT` and the average of `TAT - TAT2` over records where both values are present. Return one row containing the average of the available per-patient PT averages and the average of the available per-patient TAT − TAT2 averages, unrounded.

Select patients who have at least one laboratory record where `U-PRO` is exactly '-' and at least one laboratory record where `RA` is exactly '-', whether or not these results occur in the same record. For each selected patient, use all their laboratory records to calculate the average non-missing `PT` and the average of `TAT - TAT2` over records where both values are present. Return one row containing the average of the available per-patient PT averages and the average of the available per-patient TAT − TAT2 averages, unrounded.
queries:
WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_difference
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS q
        WHERE q.ID = l.ID
          AND q.`U-PRO` = '-'
          AND q.RA = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY l.ID
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_pt),
    AVG(avg_tat_difference)
FROM per_patient

WITH per_patient AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt,
        AVG(CASE
            WHEN l.TAT IS NOT NULL AND l.TAT2 IS NOT NULL
            THEN l.TAT - l.TAT2
        END) AS avg_tat_difference
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    GROUP BY l.ID
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.`U-PRO` = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.RA = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT
    AVG(avg_pt),
    AVG(avg_tat_difference)
FROM per_patient
